meta.name: self-service-and-knowledge
meta.description: Builds the help center, in-product guidance, and knowledge base that let customers resolve problems without contacting anyone — content, findability, maintenance, and deflection measurement. Use this to build or fix a help center, reduce support volume, write documentation for customers, improve findability, or decide what deserves a help article versus a product fix.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建自助帮助中心，让客户自行解决常见问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果客户总为同样的问题反复咨询，需要一个自助知识库来减轻支持团队的负担。
copy.tagline_en: Build a self-service help center and knowledge base to cut support volume.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if customers ask the same questions and you need self-service docs to cut tickets.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会围绕帮助中心、产品内引导和知识库工作:判断某个问题该写文章还是修产品,按客户联系量排序写说明,让内容容易被搜到,并定期检查维护、衡量自助服务是否真的减少了客户求助。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建或改进帮助中心、为客户写文档、减少支持量等,或想判断某问题该写文章还是修产品时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看客服聊天记录里,客户最常问的三个问题是什么?
say.note: 会据此按联系量排序文章主题。

say.text: 把“忘记密码”的流程写成一篇帮助文章,标题用客户可能搜的词。
检查浏览量高但之后联系客服也没减少的文章。
say.note: 识别回答不上问题的文章。

howto.what_en: Claude builds help-center content, in-product guidance, and knowledge base: decides what deserves an article vs a product fix, ranks topics by contact volume, improves findability, and maintains/measures deflection.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build or fix a help center, write customer documentation, reduce support volume, improve findability, or decide whether an issue needs an article or a product fix.

say_en.text: Look at support chats and list the three most common customer questions.
say_en.note: Ranks article topics by contact volume.

say_en.text: Write a help article for the 'forgot password' flow, titled with search terms customers use.
say_en.note: Organizes content around the customer's task.

say_en.text: Check help articles with high views but no drop in follow-up contacts.
